summary: Synthesis gives 1960 cells and 26049.984 um^2. Pre-layout (ideal clock) setup worst slack is +3.322 ns (tt), +0.306 ns (ss, worst corner) and +4.486 ns (ff); hold worst slack is +0.269 ns (tt), +0.821 ns (ss) and +0.073 ns (ff), so no violations in this data. The worst setup paths run from one register bit (_3259_, likely a read-pointer bit) through the 16:1 read mux (mux4_2 + mux2_2) and an a21o_4 gate to rd_data outputs; 3.65 ns of the 6.44 ns arrival is the clock-to-Q of a dfxtp_2 driving fanout 128 (max_fanout is 10), so the path is limited by fanout, not by logic depth.
assumptions: All numbers are quoted from reports/synth_tool.json; no tool was run in this task.

Flop _3259_ (net _0001_) is assumed to be a read-pointer address bit and the a21o_4 to be the empty-gating of rd_data; inferred from path structure and the spec, not from a name map.
STA is pre-layout with ideal clocks and no extracted parasitics, as stated in the tool report.
TNS is not in the tool output; it is not quoted as a tool value.
The worst-path report is truncated after 5 paths; only those are described, not 10.
